Book correction: The answer key prints part (vi) as \sin 39^{\circ}, without the minus sign. This is wrong: 219^{\circ} is in quadrant III, where sine is negative. The correct answer is -\sin 39^{\circ}.

Book correction: The answer key prints part (vii) as \cot 33^{\circ}, without the minus sign. This is wrong: tangent is odd, so \tan(-597^{\circ}) = -\tan 237^{\circ}, and \tan 237^{\circ} = \cot 33^{\circ} is positive. The correct answer is -\cot 33^{\circ}.

Book correction: The answer key prints part (viii) as \sin 21^{\circ}, without the minus sign. This is wrong: \cos(-111^{\circ}) = \cos 111^{\circ}, and 111^{\circ} is in quadrant II, where cosine is negative. The correct answer is -\sin 21^{\circ}.

Book correction: The answer key prints part (ix) as \sin 30^{\circ}, without the minus sign. This is wrong: sine is odd, so \sin(-390^{\circ}) = -\sin 390^{\circ} = -\sin 30^{\circ}. The correct answer is -\sin 30^{\circ}.
